name: hot_night_same_mode_pre_cool_wakeup_keeps_cool_1417
description: Issue #1417 (mirror of #1416): a thermostat that does NOT report hvac_action, a heat wave. Cool is armed all evening (cool 74, then the 72 sleep band at bedtime); the 02:30 overnight pre-cool lowers it to cool 70 in the mode already armed, and the 30-minute cycle keeps the pre-cool (re-asserting cool 70 at 05:00 and 06:00). At the 06:30 wake-up the house reads 70.5 F, inside the 2 F heat arming margin of the 70/74 day band. Before the fix nothing recorded that the cool side ran (no hvac_action, and a same-mode pre-cool is not a mode change), so the wake-up armed heat 70 F on a 95 F day. Now every accepted pre-cool write records 'cool ran', the settling guard holds cool, and wake-up writes cool 74 F.

events.note: The 30-minute cycle while the pre-cool is held (modelled explicitly).

assertions.reason: The pre-cool is written in the mode already armed (cool): no mode change, so before #1417 no 'cool ran' record existed.

Pre-cool to 70 F (sleep_cool 72 + the hot-day modifier -2), written exactly once after the 22:30 bedtime write. On real HA the coordinator's own 02:30 pre-cool timer makes this write and the scenario's pre_cool event only moves the clock (Issue #1420); before #1420 the event called the handler as well, so the test saw it written twice.
No mode change at wake-up: the pre-cool (re-asserted at 06:00) counts as 'cool ran', so the settling guard keeps cool. Before #1417 the thermostat was switched to heat here on a 95 F day.
Wake-up writes the day band in cool: cool 74 F, the AC idles (indoor 70.5 F). Before #1417 it was heat 70 F, the furnace armed 0.5 F under the house temperature.

verdict.summary: Without hvac_action, wake-up after a same-mode overnight pre-cool keeps cool armed instead of arming the furnace
verdict.observed_behavior: 06:30 wake-up: cool 74 F, no mode write.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: on a hot morning after a pre-cool the AC side stays armed and idles; the furnace is not armed just under the house temperature.
verdict.effectiveness: Fails on 2523b71 (5e33f00^, before #1416/#1417) and on f877c50: 06:30 set_hvac_mode heat + heat 70 F. Removing the pre-cool 'ran' record (_note_deliberate_command in _apply_comfort_band), or the guard's read of it (minutes_since_deliberate_command in _minutes_since_family_ran), brings that back. The hold comes from the 06:00 re-assert (30 min old at wake-up); the 02:30 write alone is 240 min old, outside the 120-minute window. Real HA cannot catch this: its thermostat reports hvac_action, and this scenario passes there on the old code too.
verdict.alignment: docs/comfort-edge-selection-spec.md R3 (a deliberate write counts as 'ran' even when the mode is unchanged, Issues #1416/#1417) and section 6 item 1 (wake-up after pre-cool); docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md section 6f.
verdict.user_outcome: If this regressed, a home whose thermostat reports no hvac_action would get the furnace armed every hot morning after an overnight pre-cool, the flip-flop the settling guard exists to prevent.
